tips.text.letsdo.bakery: Baking is a multi-step process: dough is kneaded, then baked at a Stove, then glazed and decorated before it's finished.
tips.text.letsdo.chickencoop: The Chicken Coop works like a bee nest: up to 9 chickens can enter it to lay eggs automatically. You can use a pitchfork to eject them from the coop.
tips.text.letsdo.garbage: Bins fill up like Composters, and drop a Trash Bag once full. The Trash Bag has a chance of dropping any item in the game.
tips.text.letsdo.cheese: Making cheese requires milking a cow, brewing Rennet in a Cookpot on a Cooking Frame, then pressing the milk and Rennet together in a Cheese Form to produce one of several cheese varieties.
tips.text.hamsters.variants: Adorable Hamster Pets has over 3,000 wild hamster variants and up to 2.2 million possible bred combinations.
tips.text.hamsters.shoulders: Feeding a hamster cheese lets you shoulder-mount it, and shoulder-mounted hamsters can sniff out diamonds and warn of nearby Creepers.
tips.text.artifacts.mimic: Artifacts hides its loot in structure chests, archaeology sites, and an underground campsite guarded by a totally unsuspicious chest.
tips.text.autumnity.snails: Giant Snails breed when given mushroom stew and leave a trail of goo when fed mushrooms. Baby giant snails drop shell pieces when they grow up. These are used to craft shell armor and building blocks.
tips.text.autumnity.turkeys: Turkeys are a chicken-like mob whose meat can be placed as a block, similar to a cake. Wait, are turkeys just cakes with feathers?
tips.text.betterarchaeology.enchantments: The Archeology Table converts an Unidentified Artifact into one of three enchanted books (Penetrating Strike, Soaring Winds, or Tunneling), each with an equal chance of being selected.
tips.text.betterarchaeology.brushes: Iron and Diamond Brushes are upgraded tools for excavating Suspicious Red Sand, Suspicious Dirt, and Fossiliferous Dirt found in the mod's structures.
tips.text.comforts.sleepingbags: Comforts sleeping bags let you skip the night without changing your spawn point.
tips.text.comforts.hammocks: Sleeping in a hammock allows you to pass the day instead of the night. However, this does not provide you will a Well Rested effect.
tips.text.contact.mailbox: A Mailbox must be bound by shift-right-clicking it with an empty hand before it can receive mail, and it notifies the player when a delivery arrives. You can also bind a mailbox to your FTB Team by going into your questbook and clicking 'Click to get
tips.text.contact.wrappingpaper: Wrapping Paper can be right-clicked to pack up to 4 items into a parcel for sending through a Postbox.
tips.text.critterscompanions.otters: Otters from Critters and Companions open clams for a small chance at a pearl!
tips.text.critterscompanions.ferrets: Ferrets from Critters and Companions dig up loot every five minutes once tamed with raw rabbit. Also they're stinky. And don't let them near your pet bunnies!
tips.text.critterscompanions.stickbugs: Stickbugs LOVE music, and will dance their little hearts out if you play something on a Jukebox.
tips.text.critterscompanions.rolypolys: Roly-Polys, otherwise known as isopods, are tameable with mushrooms, and tamed Roly Polys can carry around your items when shift-clicked with a Chest.
tips.text.critterscompanions.snails: Snails can be tamed with leaves, and can be harvested to get Snail Slime, which brews Potions of Resistance.
tips.text.critterscompanions.weevils: Weevils not only have the boots and the snoots, but also the shoots! Tame them with Acorns and they will launch blocks at hostile creatures!
tips.text.advancements: Feeling lost? Don't forget that many mods have guided progression through their Advancements! Press L to access the Advancements menu.
tips.text.anvil: You can restore Anvil durability by right clicking it with a block of iron.
tips.text.carryon: Shift + right click to pick up most entities and tile entities such as chests! You can also stack animals this way.
tips.text.composter: Rotten Flesh can now be placed in the Composter.
tips.text.curios: Totems of Undying can be equipped as Curios (worn accessories, separate from armor). Your curios inventory is accessed via the button to the upper left of your character portrait in inventory.
tips.text.eccentrictome: The Eccentric Tome holds many different guidebooks. Right click it to view selectable books. Left click it in the air to reset it from a selected book. Crouch and throw the Tome when a book is selected to remove that book from it. Craft the Tome with a book to hold that book inside it.
tips.text.ghasts: Ghasts will sometimes cry tears without being slain, allowing you to collect them without fighting.
tips.text.hangingsign: You can use Hanging Signs as doggy doors! Tame animals can pass through them! However, beware of baby zombies...
tips.text.hoeharvest: Hoes can harvest crops and grass in a 3x3 or 5x5 area.
tips.text.infinity: You no longer have to be holding an arrow for an Infinity Bow to work.
tips.text.inventorymove: Hold shift and drag click to deposit multiple things quickly, or hold space and click to transfer an entire inventory back and forth.
tips.text.inventorysort: Press the middle mouse button in an inventory to sort it.
tips.text.lassos: You can use Mob Lassos to transport animals and mobs between locations!
tips.text.lootbeams: Dropped items will be highlighted with a colored beam of light, to help you find them.
tips.text.lootr: In multiplayer: Chest and Barrel loot is PER PERSON, meaning that if you leave a looted chest intact, another user can get their own stuff from it. Looted chests and barrels will change their textures from gold to silver.
tips.text.market: Can't find that one seed or sapling? Try the Farming for Blockheads Market!
tips.text.mobfarm: The days of needing to use spawners to farm mobs are over! Instead, try the Easy Mob Farm mod!
tips.text.notes: Frequently forget what you were doing? Press N to take notes! You can even pin them, and they'll show up on the side of your screen, like a sticky note!
tips.text.oculus: This modpack supports shaders by default, without using OptiFine! This is thanks to the Oculus mod. I recommend Complementary Reimagined!
tips.text.paintings: You can cycle through paintings by right clicking one on the wall, while holding one in your hand.
tips.text.poisonbaby: You can stunt the growth of an animal by feeding it a Poisonous Potato. Have Forever Kittens! All you needed to do was poison a baby.
tips.text.preventspawn: There are multiple ways to prevent hostiles from getting to your base. You can craft a Magnum Torch and place it down to prevent spawns, or use Enchanted Ash as a perimeter to prevent undead from crossing. The Interdiction Torch also pushes hostile mobs away!
tips.text.quests: Press - to access your Quests without using the Quest Book. These are designed to guide you through the mods in the pack, and reward you while doing so!
tips.text.randommusic: Random music started playing? Look around for mobs, which may have invisible backpacks with jukebox upgrades!
tips.text.shulkies: Shulker boxes preview their contents when hovered over. Right click an item on a Shulker box in your inventory to place the item easily inside.
tips.text.signediting: Right click on a Sign to edit the text.
tips.text.silverfish: Looking for silverfish? They look like rats in this modpack! On a similar note: seen a rat lately? It's actually a silverfish!
tips.text.skulls: You can place candles on skulls to be ULTRA GOTH.
tips.text.snifferegg: Hatching a Sniffer? Place the egg on Moss to grow it twice as fast!
tips.text.sniffers: Sniffers can now be saddled and ridden! You can also give them chests, which they will place their foraged items into.
tips.text.soundmuffler: You can mute any sound in the game with Extreme Sound Muffler. By default, press F6 to access its menu.
tips.text.tiab: Time in a Bottle is an item used to speed up progress on things like Furnaces, Compost, and more! It accumulates time while held in your inventory or placed in a Curio slot.
tips.text.tooltips: Looking for something like raw ingredients, light sources, or flowers in JEI? They are helpfully tooltipped, so you can just search 'ingredient' or 'glows' or 'flowers!'
tips.text.trulytreasures: Mending and Frost Walker can't be bought from villagers - only Wandering Traders will have these rare books!
tips.text.veinminer: You can break multiple similar blocks at once by holding the ` key as you mine.
tips.text.villagers: You can pick up Villagers by holding shift and right clicking them!
tips.text.void: Afraid of the void? Don't be! If you fall into the void, you'll simply be teleported up to world height so you can control your descent toward land.
tips.text.voicechat: If your server operator has it set up, you can now use proximity voice chat! Press 'v' by default to change your settings.
tips.text.waystones: Using a Warp Scroll or Warp Stone will cost EXP, but traveling from one Waystone to another is free! Waystones found in the wild cannot be obtained and relocated.
tips.text.weather: Hate the rain? Love thunderstorms? Change your clientside weather with the /clientweather command! Note that in singleplayer, this will change the ACTUAL weather.
